scope: Diagnostic classification, fresh fixed-crop fitting, and actual editable SVG replay. No production changes, relaxed feature gates, or newly recovered original benchmark cases. Full experimental corpus replay is pending.

classification.scope: Photo classification only. Fixed production corners, translated by at most one original source pixel; JPEG and half-resolution variants keep the same physical quadrilateral. Reference region pixels are mapped through the photograph into each new crop. No solver, target editing, changed feature thresholds or newly accepted templates.

features.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement.

limitations: A shifted crop is a different target; the original benchmark remains 25/31.
An unstable classified component is not proved to be photographic noise.
Downsampling removes the real bird eye too; scale instability cannot safely decide which details to discard.
The crossed-ribbon prototype does not invoke the changed budget path; its error variation is not credited to the change.
Prototype has not passed full corpus and regression checks.
